annotations.title: How often an employer replies to applications

description: How often an employer replies to applications. For "do they actually reply?". From Job Spotter users who track their applications: the share of applications that got any answer (interview, offer or rejection) within the time tracked, and the usual wait. Shown only from 5 tracked applications, so nobody can be singled out.
name: employer_reply_rate
